newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: N.Korean soldier defects across border to South.
newsitem.headline: N.Korean soldier defects across border to South.

text.p: A North Korean soldier defected to South Korea through the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) dividing the two Koreas, Seoul's Defence Ministry said on Sunday.
"Sergeant First Class Kwak Kyoung-il defected to one of our observation posts at the eastern part of the border line at 12:50 p.m. (0350 GMT) today," a ministry statement said.
The statement quoted Kwak as saying he attempted to defect on Saturday but that he had to spend the night within the buffer zone after being chased by North Korean soldiers.
He was slightly injured and immediately sent to hospital after he crossed the border, the statement said, adding that details would be announced later as investigations were under way.
South and North Korea have been technically at war since the 1950-53 Korean War ended in a truce rather than a peace agreement.
A massive manhunt continued on Sunday for three of the 26 North Korean infiltrators who came ashore last month after their submarine ran aground off the east coast city of Kangnung.
So far 22 of them have been killed by South Korean soldiers or found dead and one has been captured alive.
